anomalies.evidence: evidence-run-finance.json — CEO m2 hints_visible 4/3/4/4 against FINANCE m2 hints_visible 0/0/0/0 on the same four surfaces with identical states. Mechanism, read rather than measured: evidence-common.mjs forceOnboardingMode maps the rows of a PostgREST array, so an identity with no notification_preferences row gets [] back unchanged, and AuthContext.jsx:168-175 (maybeSingle ⇒ null ⇒ 0) resolves to mode 0. Hint.jsx has no permission gate, so this is not a product difference — but I ran no database query, so it stays a hypothesis.

blind_spot: Every number here is one date, and the aging surface is a pure function of that date. Today (16/09/2026) not one of the 35 open invoices sits exactly on its מועד-פירעון — the nearest is one day past it (פרויקט 1,554, sent 15/08, due 15/09) and eight sit at "0 ימים · שוטף" before it. That is precisely the boundary spec §3.1 says broke five times in one day (−1 ⇒ 0 ⇒ "שוטף"), and this run never touches it: no row exercises the boundary, so a sign error there would render as a clean page in all 35 screenshots. Checkable without me: put one invoice whose invoice_sent_at + תנאי_תשלום_ימים equals the run date into the data and confirm it renders "שוטף · 0 ימים" and is counted in the side tile rather than in 1–30.
